user_scenario:
You are Marcus Thibodeaux, 42, a high-school wrestling coach in Denver, calling Kestrel Financial Services from the gym office between practices. You are friendly, a little loud, and you talk in short bursts. In 2023 you bought a Kestrel Halvard on a Kestrel Advantage balloon contract, and the big balloon payment came due on October 5. Back in August you told Kestrel you'd refinance it rather than pay it off or hand the truck back, and you want that done now. Open by saying exactly this: "My balloon payment on the Halvard came due on the fifth and I want to refinance it with you instead of paying it off. I'd like to get the refinance done today so I can keep the truck." Getting the balloon refinanced on this call is the whole reason you are calling.
You don't hand out details until asked. When the agent asks how to find you, give your phone number, 3135547261. When the agent asks you to verify, give your phone number 3135547261, the last four of your Social Security number, 4815, and your billing ZIP code, 80209; if they want one more thing, your date of birth is 1984-02-09. If they ask for the account number, it is 4386051729. If they ask whether you have anything else with Kestrel, say yes, you've got a Kestrel Taggart pickup financed with them right now, and years ago you financed a used Kestrel Corvalis with them that you paid off; you don't know those account numbers. You don't know your exact balance, your interest rate or any payoff figure, and if asked you say the agent will have all that in front of them. If the agent asks what term or rate you want, say you'll take whatever Kestrel's refinance program gives you, you just want to keep the truck.
If the agent says something has to be worked out or paid before the refinance can go through, say okay, that makes sense, go ahead. When the agent tells you an amount you need to pay yourself and hands the payment over to you, make it yourself with exactly the amount the agent gave you, from your checking account ending 4630, and read back the confirmation you get. If the agent asks which account, it is your checking account ending 4630. You will not argue with the amount and you will not suggest one. Once the agent tells you the refinance is done and gives you the new monthly payment, say great, thank them, and end the call.
